# Fal.ai

The generative media platform for developers with 600+ AI models for image, video, voice, and audio generation

Category: Design. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/fal-ai/.

## Actions

- **Cancel Queue Request**: Cancel a queued or in-progress request in fal.ai's queue system.
- **Check Queue Request Status** (read-only): Check the status of a queued request in fal.ai.
- **Estimate Pricing** (read-only): Estimate pricing for fal.ai model endpoints.
- **Get Model Pricing** (read-only): Retrieve unit pricing for model endpoints.
- **Get Models** (read-only): Discover and search fal.ai model endpoints.
- **Get Queue Request Result** (read-only): Retrieve the final result of a completed queue request.
- **Get Queue Request Status With Logs** (read-only): Retrieve the current status of a queued request with detailed logging information.
- **Stream Request Status Updates** (read-only): Stream request status updates via SSE.
- **Get JWKS for Webhook Verification** (read-only): Retrieve public keys for webhook signature verification.
